howToPlay: Use your basic attack to hit enemies and splash damage targets behind them. Place your cannon in a safe spot to control the map, using gadgets to defend your position or pressure enemies across the field.
gears: Equip PET POWER to increase your cannon's effectiveness and DAMAGE to maximize your output. SHIELD or HEALTH are excellent choices to improve survivability while you hold your ground.
trait: This controller suits players who enjoy tactical positioning and area denial to dictate the flow of the match.
